name: security-azure-keyvault-data-authority-review
intent: Key Vault control-plane versus secret/key data-plane permissions
artifacts: Vault permission model, RBAC/access policies, network constraints, version handling and requested data operation.
trace: Resolve the actual principal and management versus data permissions. Follow which actions expose secret values or allow signing/decryption rather than only listing metadata.
experiment: Use an owned vault with synthetic content; compare the intended data operation and a restricted owned role/version.
disproof: Vault discovery or management-plane read is not secret-value access; report the specific successful data operation.
repair: Limit data-plane authority and delegation changes, retesting value access, versions and permitted operations.
branch_decisions: Identify the vault permission model: Azure RBAC and legacy access policies have different evaluation paths. Control-plane visibility is distinct from secret values or key cryptographic operations, but a policy-management grant may create a delegation path. Evaluate that path from supplied assignments/source without granting roles or retrieving real secrets merely to demonstrate it.
